I’m ready to determine the SMILES string, but I need some information about the compound you have. Could you please provide any of the following details?

- Molecular formula (or exact mass)
- A brief description of functional groups or the type of compound (e.g., “a phenyl‑propanoic acid”, “an aromatic aldehyde”, etc.)
- ¹H NMR data (chemical shifts, multiplicities, integration)
- ¹³C NMR data (chemical shifts)
- IR spectrum key absorptions
- Mass‑spectrometry data (m/z values, especially the molecular ion)

With at least one of these pieces of information I can deduce the structure and give you the correct SMILES notation.
